intro: The Aline Dining Chair stands out with its distinctive bent ply seat and fabric backrest. Crafted in solid rubberwood with a unique wooden seat design, it brings character and comfort to modern dining spaces.

features.title: Unique Bent Ply Seat
features.text: Flaunting a wooden seat, Aline features a bent ply design that offers firm, supportive seating with a sculptural quality. This distinctive construction adds visual interest while maintaining everyday durability.

features.title: Fabric Backrest for Comfort
features.text: Upholstered in blue fabric, the backrest provides soft, breathable support that contrasts beautifully with the wooden seat. The cushioned backing makes extended sitting more comfortable during meals or conversations.

features.title: Solid Rubberwood Frame
features.text: Crafted from durable rubberwood with a walnut finish, the frame delivers reliable strength that withstands daily use. Plus, seasoned construction resists wear while maintaining its rich, warm appearance over time.

features.title: Contemporary Two-Tone Design
features.text: The combination of a wooden seat and fabric backrest creates a striking visual balance that feels modern and intentional. This design approach adds personality to dining areas without overwhelming the space.

features.title: Knockdown Construction
features.text: Easy-to-assemble knockdown design simplifies setup and allows practical disassembly when needed.

features.title: Pairs with Glass-Top Tables
features.text: Designed to complement the Aline glass-top dining table, this chair creates a cohesive, contemporary dining set. The walnut finish harmonises beautifully with various table styles and finishes.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
